_help: Answer key for tests/check_samples.py, written by reading the scans.
order / employees: element key -> expected English value.
A key that is not listed must come out BLANK (the document does not state it).
"?" = the document leaves it unclear (e.g. which of two offices is the posting): blank or a value are both accepted (shown for review).
A list = several acceptable answers (all stated in the document).
Values are compared loosely (transliteration differs); dates exactly.
legacy: documents that go to the old Suspension Orders sheet; only the listed keys are checked.
